Hens/cragson-PS5Hen/ps5-hen.elf.title: cragson-PS5Hen
Hens/cragson-PS5Hen/ps5-hen.elf.description: Defeats the Hypervisor on firmware <= 4.51 and enables support for homebrew and PS4 FPKGs.
Hens/cragson-PS5Hen/ps5-hen.elf.author: cragson
Hens/cragson-PS5Hen/ps5-hen.elf.instructions: Start elfldr using a compatible exploit, close the exploit application, then send the HEN and wait for its notification.

Hens/etaHEN-LightneingMods/etaHEN-2.5B.b.title: etaHEN
Hens/etaHEN-LightneingMods/etaHEN-2.5B.b.author: LightningMods / etaHEN team
Hens/etaHEN-LightneingMods/etaHEN-2.5B.b.description: All-in-one PS5 homebrew enabler with Toolbox settings and cheat support. Release 2.5B adds a choice of cheat repositories, fan settings, a beta game/app dumper, and WebMAN Games fixes.
Hens/etaHEN-LightneingMods/etaHEN-2.5B.b.instructions: Start a compatible jailbreak and elfldr, then send etaHEN-2.5B.bin. This BIN contains an ELF payload and is sent unchanged.
Hens/etaHEN-LightneingMods/etaHEN-2.5B.b.compatibilityNote: The linked 2.5B release does not state a complete firmware support list. Compatibility is shown as unknown rather than inferred from newer releases.

Hens/onionHEN-aydencharles/OnionHEN.elf.title: onionHEN
Hens/onionHEN-aydencharles/OnionHEN.elf.author: aydencharles
Hens/onionHEN-aydencharles/OnionHEN.elf.description: PS5 homebrew enabler and Toolbox built on etaHEN, with cheats, an overlay, payload management, and background services. This release adds 13.xx firmware support and improves empty cheat menus.
Hens/onionHEN-aydencharles/OnionHEN.elf.instructions: After a cold boot, jailbreak and start external elfldr on port 9021. Send OnionHEN.elf once and wait for startup. Do not load it alongside etaHEN or other hotkey injectors. OnionHEN uses /data/OnionHEN/cheats; this site's cheat installer continues to target /data/etaHEN/cheats.
Hens/onionHEN-aydencharles/OnionHEN.elf.compatibilityNote: Upstream adds 13.00–13.60 to the earlier 4.03–12.70 support range; support on 5.50 is conditional. The local ELF matches the SHA-256 published for v0.9.0.

Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.title: PS5SX2 — PS2 Emulator Installer
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.author: Swordpdf / PCSX2 contributors
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.description: A native PS2 emulator for jailbroken PS5 consoles, based on PCSX2 with Vulkan graphics. This installer downloads the app from GitHub; later updates can be started inside PS5SX2.
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.compatibilityNote: Upstream reports testing through 13.60. USB keyboard/mouse support has limitations on 11.x and 12.00; this does not describe controller compatibility.
requirements: Jailbroken PS5 with kstuff and ShadowMountPlus.
Load the PS5SX2 helper appropriate to your ShadowMountPlus version.
Internet access for the installer download.
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.bios: Use your own dumped PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios. The bundled OpenPS2BIOS is experimental.
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.games: Place your game backups in /data/PCSX2/games (.iso, .chd, .cso or .zso).
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.controls: D-pad/stick: browse; Cross/OPTIONS: play; Square: settings. Hold L2 + D-pad Down for one second for the in-game menu.
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.uninstall: No uninstall procedure is specified in the linked release. Consult upstream and back up personal emulator data before removal.
Emulators/PS5SX2/PS5SX2Installer.elf.instructions: Load the required helper and kstuff/ShadowMountPlus, then send this installer. The helper is not included in this Manager entry. The installer can fetch a newer app build than the release linked here.

ModMenus/RaringM/gtav-menu-daemon.elf.title: RaringM — GTA V
ModMenus/RaringM/gtav-menu-daemon.elf.author: RaringM
ModMenus/RaringM/gtav-menu-daemon.elf.compatibilityNote: Targets documented by the project; confirm the bundled build matches your game. Story Mode only.

ModMenus/RaringM/gtav-menu-daemon.elf.instructions: The daemon includes its workers; no separate worker upload is needed.

ModMenus/PSN-HUB/PSN-HUB-GTAV-Menu.elf.title: PSN-HUB | GTA V
ModMenus/PSN-HUB/PSN-HUB-GTAV-Menu.elf.author: PSN-HUB · ItssJustAaron
ModMenus/PSN-HUB/PSN-HUB-GTAV-Menu.elf.compatibilityNote: GTA V Enhanced Story Mode. Mission skip actions are enabled for the EU disc build PPSA04263 01.010.002.
ModMenus/PSN-HUB/PSN-HUB-GTAV-Menu.elf.description: GTA V Enhanced Story Mode tools in a purple PSN-HUB panel with the original site mascot in the banner when the PSN-HUB Brand pack is loaded, lime selection and navigation bars, a leaf watermark on the main menu, and a Missions section.
ModMenus/PSN-HUB/PSN-HUB-GTAV-Menu.elf.controls: R1 + D-pad Left opens or hides the menu. Use the D-pad to browse and adjust, Cross to select, and Circle to go back.
ModMenus/PSN-HUB/PSN-HUB-GTAV-Menu.elf.instructions: Fully close GTA V before switching menu builds. Stop any other GTA V menu loader, send this ELF, and launch Story Mode. To show the original artwork, install the psnhub-brand texture pack from the project folder, select PSN-HUB Brand under Custom Packs > Manage Packs, then choose Load. On the supported EU build, open Missions during a fresh Prologue and select Complete Prologue. Return to the main menu, then choose Continue Story. During gameplay, select Skip Checkpoint or Complete Mission and close the mod menu. The request is armed for two minutes. On an eligible Mission Failed screen with a recorded checkpoint, press Square and confirm in GTA V. Complete Mission requires a checkpoint that supports a whole-mission skip.
